about.author: @Kaiconure
documentation: This gambit allows you to set up a multi-stage weapon skill/skillchain sequence.

commands: vars.ws.multi_stage.stages and \
(log('Preparing to test multi-stage configuration...') and isNextMultiStageOpener(vars.ws.multi_stage) or log('Multi-stage test completed!')) or \
(log('A valid multi-stage configuration was not found.'))
functions.name: test/multi-stage

commands: -----The first thing we'll do is apply any stage overrides. This includes the possibility of actually creating the
-----stages themselves using nothing but the overrides.
logf('Applying overrides for %s weapon skill stages!', _tblue(arrayCount(vars.ws.multi_stage.overrides)))
arrayCount(vars.ws.multi_stage.stages) > 0 or setVar('vars.ws.multi_stage.stages', {})
arrayInherit(vars.ws.multi_stage.stages, vars.ws.multi_stage.overrides, true)
-----If there are no stages defined, we'll null out the stage variables and log that fact.
setVar('vars.ws.multi_stage.stages', nil)
log(_tgray('No weapon skill stages were defined!'))
vars.ws.multi_stage.stages and \
logf('Identified %s weapon skill stages!', _tblue(arrayCount(vars.ws.multi_stage.stages))) or \
log(_tgray('No weapon skill stages were defined!'))
-----There are stages, so log how many we've got defined.
logf('Identified %s weapon skill stages!', _tblue(arrayCount(vars.ws.multi_stage.stages)))
logf('Configuring multi-stage skillchain delay to: %.1fs', vars.ws.multi_stage.skillchain_delay)
sendCommand('gbt config -scd %.1f', vars.ws.multi_stage.skillchain_delay)
$macro:close_skillchain
$macro:open_skillchain
